suite: native provider credential storage and OAuth API compatibility
runtime: Selected installed managed Pi 1.3.0; native ModelRuntime and core/auth-storage.js
verified: Provider metadata loads without creating auth.json or contacting a provider
Native locked API-key writes use private 0600 auth.json and preserve concurrent native writers
A saved credential becomes actual ModelRuntime.getAuth request auth after registry invalidation
Native config-value templates resolve only for deliberate credential resolution
Credential enumeration never executes saved command keys
Local OAuth manual and secret input, device notifications, cancellation, timeout and supersede
Local callback listeners close on cancellation and before superseding flows
Cancelled late credentials are discarded and submitted codes are never persisted or echoed in errors
Cross-type writes and API-row removal of OAuth credentials return conflict
Corrupt, symlinked and group/world-readable credential stores are refused without overwriting bytes
Stored OAuth without a registered login handler stays visible and removable
Custom Radius gateways do not offer the default Radius login
fixtureScope: Synthetic credentials and local callback listeners under /tmp only; no production credential changes or external provider/model requests
integration: Root wires handle(input), onCredentialsChanged invalidation/native refresh, and dispose()
requirements: Extension-owned OAuth providers must be registered into the host runtime; missing handlers return provider-auth-login-unavailable
Radius MCP follow-up requires injected radiusMcp.status/configure callbacks; unavailable wiring returns 503
A credential file with broader permissions requires owner-only permissions before this API writes it
